_comment: RAG golden set derived from the 5-book corpus. Same schema as ../golden_set.json: the evaluator scores an answer by the fraction of 'must_include' tokens present (case-insensitive substring). EASY = single retrievable fact from one book; HARD = multi-hop / synthesis / cross-book, where a weaker model with the same retrieved passages tends to drop required detail.
